answer_1.quote: We produce a novel MFT assessment tool: a Moral Foundations Character Actions Questionnaire (MFCAQ) which can be used by readers (both human and machine) to evaluate character actions...
answer_1.outputs: Moral foundation annotations (1-5 scores for Authority, Care, Fairness, Loyalty, Purity)

answer_2.quote: To evaluate model performance on this task, we use Spearman's rank correlation coefficient (ρ) to compare model outputs to averaged human annotations...

answer_3.quote: We collect LLM responses to the MCAQ using five language models... prompting GPT-4o to identify the main character(s)...

answer_4.quote: Five experienced undergraduate annotators... independently rated each story using our adapted MFT questionnaire.
answer_4.guideline: MFCAQ codebook with 16 items assessing moral dimensions
criteria: Moral foundation relevance (Authority, Care, Fairness, Loyalty, Purity)
